description: Grants the web app (served by the bundled Next server on a loopback port, i.e. a REMOTE origin for Tauri) exactly the app commands it drives: raw-ZPL label transport, the update check/apply pair, and the Wave 38 lane 2 native window commands (open/focus role windows, route meridian:// links — geometry persistence is Rust-side window events, not renderer-driven). No plugin permissions are granted to this origin and no core permission is needed to invoke app commands. Since tauri 2.11.1 remote origins are ACL-gated for custom commands too, so without this capability all commands are denied in the real shell. 'main' plus 'subwindow::*' labels: every native role window carries the same remote origin and drives the same command surface (ZPL printing works from ANY window).
